origin: Vectan reloading catalogue (Nobel Sport), shotshell data (12, 16 and 20 gauge, lead shot; loads, velocities, psi pressures; scripts/data/loaddata/vectan_shot_extract.py)
descr: FOR SHOTSHELLS ONLY (caliber with Shotshell = yes). The burn rate Ba is fitted to 10 published shotgun loads with the shotshell model of the solver (shot column and 2.5 g wad as the projectile, 28 inch barrel; mostly 12 gauge 2 3/4"): velocity error 2.3 % rms, pressure error 11 % rms (pressure varies with wad and primer, which the model does not know). With a rifle or handgun cartridge the value is wrong: use another record of this powder. Not published and therefore only typical values: Qex, k, material and bulk density, form function. Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data.

origin: Vectan reloading catalogue (Nobel Sport), rifle tables (read by OCR, scripts/data/loaddata/vectan_extract.py)
descr: Burn rate Ba fitted to 77 start and maximum loads of the manufacturer's published load data (23 cartridges), velocity error 6.5 % rms. Not published and therefore only typical or chosen values: Qex (the maker states single-base), k, material density pc, bulk density pcd, and the form function (a0, z1, z2: the data hardly determine it). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data. The catalogue gives no test barrel and no pressures: a barrel of 600 mm was assumed (a 100 mm shorter barrel gives a burn rate about 10 % higher), so the burn rate is only as good as that assumption. Bullet lengths are estimated from mass, diameter and type. Fewer data or a poorer fit than most other records: use with more caution.
